scenes.headline: pytest for Data Pipelines
scenes.subtitle: Trustworthy transforms and schemas
scenes.narration: pytest makes it straightforward to prove that your transformations, schemas, and edge cases behave correctly before any data reaches production and causes silent damage.

scenes.headline: What to test in a pipeline
items: Transformation logic against known sample rows
Schema and data-type contracts on the output
Edge cases like nulls, duplicates, and empty inputs
scenes.narration: Focus your tests on the pure transformation functions, feeding them known input rows and asserting on the exact output. Verify the schema and data types of what your pipeline emits, since a downstream table depends on that contract. And deliberately probe the messy edge cases that real data always contains, because nulls, duplicates, and empty batches are where pipelines quietly break.

scenes.headline: Fixtures for sample data
scenes.narration: A fixture is a reusable setup function marked with the pytest.fixture decorator. Here sales_df builds a small DataFrame, and any test that lists sales_df as a parameter receives a fresh copy of it. The test then drops null amounts and asserts that two rows survive. This keeps every data test focused, readable, and independent of the others.

scenes.headline: Parametrizing edge cases
scenes.narration: The parametrize marker runs a single test once for each row in its list of cases. Here one concise test exercises a currency string, an empty string, and a placeholder value, checking that clean_amount handles all three. Beyond reducing duplication, this doubles as living documentation of exactly how odd inputs are expected to be normalized.

scenes.headline: Useful pytest features
items: conftest.py holds fixtures shared across many test files
tmp_path gives each test an isolated temporary directory
markers let you group slow or integration tests to run selectively
scenes.narration: Placing fixtures in a conftest.py file makes them available to every test in that directory without any import. The built-in tmp_path fixture hands each test a clean temporary directory, which is perfect for testing file readers and writers safely. Custom markers let you tag slow or integration tests so you can run the fast unit suite constantly and the heavy suite only when needed.

scenes.text: Test transforms as pure functions and validate output schemas — catch bad data in CI, before it lands in production.
scenes.narration: Treat your transformations as pure functions and assert on their output schemas, and pytest turns silent data corruption into loud, early failures. Catching bad data in continuous integration is far cheaper than discovering it in a dashboard.
